map.通过网格法或种植参数估算冠层覆盖度，评估光合截获能力: Estimate canopy coverage by grid method or planting parameters to assess light interception
map.覆盖度 = 单株冠层投影面积 ÷ (株距 × 行距) × 100% × (1 −: Coverage = per-plant canopy projection / (spacing x row) x 100% x (1 - overlap%); LAI ~ coverage x 3.5; plants/mu = 666.67 m² / per-plant footprint
map.方式一（行株距法）：单株冠层投影面积按形状取圆（πr²）、方（边长²）或椭圆（行: Method 1 (row-spacing): canopy projection by shape circle (πr²), square (side²), or ellipse (short-axis semi); divide by spacing x row for base coverage, multiply by "1 - overlap%" for mutual shading, capped at 100%. Also gives simplified LAI (coverage x 3.5) and plants/mu. Method 2 (photo grid): green cells / total cells estimates coverage.
map.在冠层俯拍照片上叠加网格，统计绿色像素格数占总格数的比例: Overlay a grid on the canopy top-view photo, count green cells over total cells
map.过高(>95%)通风不良，病害风险增加: Too high (>95%) poor ventilation, higher disease risk
map.覆盖度 = 冠层垂直投影面积 / 土地面积 × 100%。: Coverage = canopy vertical projection / land area x 100%.
map.用样点法、目视网格或图像分割估算。: Estimate by sample-point, visual grid, or image segmentation.
map.用于长势监测、除草剂喷施时机判断。: For growth monitoring and herbicide timing judgment.
map.1 m² 样方内叶片投影占 0.75 m²，则覆盖度 75%。此时封行，杂草受抑: In a 1 m² quad, leaf projection 0.75 m², coverage 75%. Canopy closed, weeds suppressed, less weeding; at only 40% weeds compete strongly, need manual/mechanical weeding.
map.封行前覆盖度上升通常伴随叶面积增加、光截获提高，有利；但过度郁闭会田间通风差、病: Before closing, rising coverage usually means more leaf area and light capture, good; but over-closure causes poor ventilation and more disease. Watch "timely closing" rather than blindly high.
map.用固定角度垂直拍摄，按绿通道阈值分割植被与土，扣除阴影。多时点同法可比长势，单张: Shoot vertically at fixed angle, threshold green channel to separate vegetation and soil, subtract shadow. Same method across times compares growth; single shot needs a calibration reference.
